destinations.name: San José Diridon
destinations.connectVia: Walk, bike, or VTA from campus
destinations.how: About a mile west of campus. VTA, Caltrain, and Highway 17 Express meet here. Caltrain from Diridon is covered; Highway 17 Express is the paid bus to Santa Cruz.

destinations.name: Berryessa/North San José
destinations.how: The BART station SJSU riders use for the East Bay and San Francisco. VTA gets you here; BART from this platform is covered by BayPass.

destinations.name: Downtown San José
destinations.how: San Pedro Square and downtown are inside the VTA grid. Walk from campus or ride light rail. Covered.

destinations.name: San Francisco
destinations.connectVia: Caltrain from Diridon, or BART from Berryessa
destinations.how: Farther than Santa Cruz, but fully on the pass. Walk or ride VTA to Diridon and take Caltrain to 4th & King, or VTA to Berryessa and BART into the city. Muni is covered once you arrive; cable cars are not.

destinations.name: Palo Alto
destinations.how: Caltrain from Diridon to Palo Alto. University Avenue is a short walk from the station. Covered.

destinations.name: Stanford
destinations.how: Caltrain from Diridon to Palo Alto, then walk or the campus shuttle. The Stanford Caltrain stop is event-only. Caltrain is covered.

destinations.name: Mountain View
destinations.how: Caltrain from Diridon to Castro Street. VTA light rail also ends at Mountain View. Covered.

destinations.name: Downtown Berkeley
destinations.how: VTA to Berryessa/North San José, then BART to Downtown Berkeley. UC Berkeley is a short walk from the station. Covered.

destinations.name: Downtown Oakland
destinations.how: VTA to Berryessa/North San José, then BART to 12th Street / Oakland City Center. Covered.

destinations.name: SFO
destinations.connectVia: BART from Berryessa, or Caltrain to Millbrae
destinations.how: BART serves the airport terminals. From campus: VTA to Berryessa, then BART — or Caltrain to Millbrae and transfer to BART. Both agencies are covered.

destinations.name: Levi's Stadium
destinations.how: VTA light rail to Great America Station, at the stadium. Covered. This is not Highway 17.

destinations.name: Gilroy
destinations.how: Caltrain south from Diridon (limited schedule). Covered. Gilroy sits near the 50-mile ring and is still on BayPass.

destinations.name: Sausalito
destinations.connectVia: Covered ride to SF, then Golden Gate Ferry
destinations.how: Get to San Francisco on Caltrain or BART (covered), then Golden Gate Ferry from the Ferry Building. The ferry is on BayPass. North Bay water is not the Santa Cruz exception.

destinations.name: Oracle Park
destinations.how: Caltrain from Diridon to San Francisco. The ballpark is a short walk from 4th & King. Covered.

destinations.name: Golden Gate Bridge
destinations.connectVia: Covered ride to SF, then Muni bus
destinations.how: Caltrain or BART into San Francisco, then a Muni bus toward the Presidio — not a cable car. Cable cars are excluded from BayPass. Golden Gate Transit is covered too.
destinations.nearbyStopName: Muni buses to the Presidio (not cable cars)

destinations.name: Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk
destinations.how: Closer than San Francisco, but not on BayPass. VTA to Diridon is covered; Highway 17 Express (dashed amber) to Santa Cruz is a separate fare. The pass stops at San José.
